title: pteris × duvalii
intro: Pteris × duvalii, commonly known as Duval's fern, is a hybrid plant species that belongs to the family Pteridaceae. This plant has been used for centuries in traditional medicine, where it is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory health, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Duval's fern include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of Pteris × duvalii have been shown to possess anti-cancer, anti-diabetic, and anti-aging effects, making it a promising plant for the development of new medicines and therapies.
